Our departments and research divisions work collaboratively to advance innovation, educator practice, and sustainability for a better future.

EDU-UOK

Established Department

18+ Years Leadership

Department of Education

Head/Lead: Dr. Divya C. Senan
(Associate Professor & Honorary Director)

Central department under University of Kerala conducting M.Ed, Ph.D coursework, and research in educational technology, curriculum modeling, and learning sciences.

CLESE-AI

Collaborations with

IIT Mumbai & EdTech Society

Learning Engineering & AI Pedagogy Division

Head/Lead: CLESE Research Core

Focuses on prompt engineering for educators, mathematical modeling in education, computing capabilities for career guidance, and AI-driven adaptive learning.

CLESE-STEM

State Level SIET &

ICSSR Funded Programmes

STEM Education & Experiential Labs Division

Head/Lead: STEM Learning Lab Director

Operates dedicated STEM learning labs, robotics workbench kits, and mobile STEM experiential vans for 44+ rural schools and 41 educational districts across Kerala.

CLESE-SUST

International

MoU Partnership

Energy & Sustainability Education Division

Head/Lead: Clarkson US Bilateral Taskforce

Curriculum integration of zero-carbon literacy, solar energy simulation, and global interdependence in collaboration with Clarkson University, USA.

Our Objectives

1

Create educational environments to address career guidance and employability for all, irrespective of barriers.

2

Build innovative digital tools that catalyse improvements in students learning.

3

Integrate AI, psychological principles, and computational methods to enhance aptitude development and employability skills.

4

Create and support opportunities for learning about sustainability through coursework, research & engagement.

5

Improve opportunities to connect sustainability, equity, and global action with academic and co-curricular life.
